unit.title: How was your weekend?
canDo: Say what you did, and didn't do
Tell a short story about a day out

vocabulary.meaning: to have fun; to hang out
to climb a mountain; to hike

example.py: Xīngqīliù wǒmen qù pá shān le.
Wǒ dì yī cì qù pá shān.
example.en: It was my first time hiking.

example.py: Xià cì wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba!

grammar.purpose: Say what happened, and what didn't
grammar.explanation: 了 after a verb marks it as done: 我看了两个电影. To say it didn't happen, use 没 and drop 了: 我没出去. Questions: 你去了吗？ / 你去没去？

examples.py: Wǒ zài jiā kàn le liǎng ge diànyǐng.
examples.en: I watched two films at home.
What did you do at the weekend?

commonMistakes.why: 没 replaces 了; they don't go together here.

grammar.purpose: Say it was the first time
grammar.explanation: 第 makes ordinal numbers: 第一 (first), 第二 (second). 第一次 + verb = the first time doing it: 我第一次去爬山.

examples.py: Wǒ dì yī cì qù pá shān.
examples.en: It was my first time hiking.

examples.py: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái Zhōngguó.
examples.en: This is my first time in China.

reading.title: My first hike
reading.purpose: Read Lin An's post. What did she do, how long did it take, and how did she feel at the end?

lines.zh: 星期六我第一次去爬山。
lines.py: Xīngqīliù wǒ dì yī cì qù pá shān.
lines.en: On Saturday I went hiking for the first time.

lines.zh: 我们早上六点起床，七点出去了。
lines.py: Wǒmen zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng, qī diǎn chūqu le.
lines.en: We got up at six and left at seven.

lines.zh: 山很高，我们走了四个小时！
lines.py: Shān hěn gāo, wǒmen zǒu le sì ge xiǎoshí!
lines.en: The mountain was high; we walked for four hours!

lines.zh: 山上很冷，可是非常漂亮。
lines.py: Shān shang hěn lěng, kěshì fēicháng piàoliang.
lines.en: It was cold at the top, but gorgeous.

lines.zh: 晚上回家，我九点就睡觉了。
lines.py: Wǎnshang huí jiā, wǒ jiǔ diǎn jiù shuìjiào le.
lines.en: Back home, I was asleep by nine.

questions.q: What time did they get up?
How did Lin An feel that evening?

lines.zh: 我们早上六点【起床】，七点出去了。
lines.py: Wǒmen zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng, qī diǎn chūqu le.
lines.en: We got up at six and left at seven.

lines.zh: 山很【高】，我们走【了】四个小时！
lines.py: Shān hěn gāo, wǒmen zǒu le sì ge xiǎoshí!
lines.en: The mountain was high; we walked for four hours!

conversation.aiPartnerBrief: You are 陈宇. Ask about the weekend and react with interest. Use verb + 了 and 没.

natural.py: Méi zuò shénme, zài jiā xiūxi.

pragmatics.note: 没做什么 + a detail keeps the chat going; a bare 没有 ends it.

pragmatics.note: A friendly way to include someone who missed out.
